name: Y2K Visual Novel Project
source:
The story takes place in the faraway year of 1999 and the project stays true to the feeling of that era. Remember when you had to use composite cables and being kind by rewinding? Good times!

[From [url=https://phantom-gd.itch.io/y2kvn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在遥远的1999年，项目忠实还原了那个时代的感觉。还记得当你不得不使用复合电缆并善意地重新缠绕时吗？美好时光！

[来自[url=https://phantom-gd.itch.io/y2kvn]itch.io[/url]]
